body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Sony showcased its 16GB HD Handycam camcorder 'HDR-CX150' at CES 2010.

Packed with features, the ultra-compact HDR-CX150 makes it easy to capture 1920 x 1080 Full HD video and 3.0-megapixel images. Equipped with an Exmor R CMOS sensor for superior low-light performance, this camcorder also features a Carl Zeiss Vario Sonnar T 25x optical zoom lens that brings you closer to the action.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
